_about: Golden path, backlog E1-S6: the ARCHITECTURE §8.2 'Anjali Das' 3-document example (scripts/make_sample_docs.py). Checked by scripts/golden_path.py. 'stub' is what the deterministic stub backend must produce (CI). 'real_vlm' is the §8.2 recorded run of the real 7B model (nightly on the pod). The vitals sheet differs on purpose: the stub follows §5 S4 (every vital with a number is emitted: pulse, respiratory rate, temperature, SpO2, weight, height + the Penicillin allergy = 7 facts); the §8.2 run of the 7B model extracted only the allergy, which §13 records as its known vitals weak spot. Counts are for a FRESH database (golden_path.py --fresh-db): the Patient and Organization are attributed to the first document that creates them, as in §8.2's own 15/12/8 split. Change a number here only with a reason in the infra backlog change log.
